verdict.rationale: Granola documents private-by-default notes: they are never shared unless you share the link or add them to a team-space folder. It also separates a private 'My notes' space from a workspace-visible team space. However, granular permission levels for links, folders or the workspace are not documented, and admin visibility into what's shared is only hinted at by audit endpoints in the API spec. Missing for 10: granular link/folder permission levels (view/edit, restricted links), an admin console or report showing shared notes, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared

citations.quote: Your notes are never shared with any participants unless you share the link, or add the note to a folder in your team space.
My notes — Your private space... [Your workspace name] — Your team space.
Folders here are visible to everyone in your workspace.
Copy link will copy a unique URL link to the meeting notes, which you can send to others.
